```text
# PR #3357: Patch: one Dialog component, and the board's confirm dialogs on it

Closes #3220

## What changed

There is now one `Dialog` component (`apps/web/src/game/Dialog.tsx`, styled by `game/dialog.css`). The board's five confirms draw through it: ConfirmConcede, ConfirmLeaveMatch, PracticeLeave, ConfirmLeaveFight and PracticeResult.

- **Close control:** a `dialog` has a ✕ at its top right, named "Close" (`dialog-close`). An `alertdialog` has no ✕; its Cancel, the safe choice, closes it. The title is always an `h2`.
- **Button order:** the safe choice comes first and has the focus. Then come the caller's actions, with any `danger` one moved last, at the right. With three answers the safe choice gets a row of its own (R765's Save and leave). At 360 px and under the row stacks in the same order.
- **Keys:** everything goes through `useModalKeys`, which takes an optional third argument, the control to focus. Escape, Back (an R2127000 layer) and a click on the scrim close the dialog, and Tab stays inside it.
- **Focus:** when the dialog closes, the focus goes back to whatever opened it. If the caller has already moved the focus (Game.tsx's `refocusConcede` sends it to the ⋯ menu on a phone), the caller's choice stands.
- **Scrim and layer:** one scrim color (wood-950 at 70 %) at `--z-dialog`. That token is the old `--z-toast-top: 72` renamed; only the concede scrim used it.
- **The five dialogs:** none keeps an `"Escape"` handler, a `useBackLayer` call, a focus effect or a scrim class of its own. `.concede-*`, `.practice-leave*` and `.practice-result-scrim` are gone.
  - Every testid is unchanged, and so are `data-can-save` and `data-outcome`.
  - The destructive answers use `button-danger`.
- **The practice result** keeps its look: `.dialog.practice-result` and `.practice-result .dialog__*` were added beside the existing `practice-result*` selectors, which the lesson result still uses. The lesson result's scrim is now called `.tutorial-result-scrim` and looks the same.
- **Spec:**
  - New ruling `spec/rulings/R3220000.md`, with its paragraph in `spec/pending/3220.md`.
  - R2127000 is amended: the practice result is now a Back layer, where Back means View the board.
  - §10.10 gets a new paragraph on the dialog convention.
  - `apps/web/README.md` gets a Dialog paragraph and an updated list of Back layers.
- **Test maps:** three entries came out of `BOARD_KEY_HANDLERS`, the notices entries moved to `game/dialog.css`, and practice.css's frozen counts fell: motion 49→45, palette 39→35, spacing 145→134, surfaces 69→64, typescale 36→33.

## Tests

- **New:** `game/Dialog.test.tsx` has 8 `R3220000` tests: Escape, Back, a scrim click, the Tab trap, focus going back to the opener (and staying where a caller moved it), the ✕'s name and place, the order, and a source scan of the five. `practice/PracticeResult.test.tsx` has 2 more: ✕, Escape, scrim click and View the board each view the board, and so does Back.
- **Web tests:** `vitest run` over the plan's set plus `src/tutorial` passed: 211 files, 3740 tests. The harness's own command (`vitest run --project web --changed origin/main` with its excludes) passed: 224 files, 4424 tests.
- **Other checks:**
  - `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`, `pnpm exec eslint apps/web` and `cargo fmt --check` are clean.
  - `cargo jackioh spec check` reported "1789 rulings … ok", and `patches check` and `catalog check` passed.
  - `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main --claims` said `Internal`, so no patch fragment is needed.
- **Cascade check:** a throwaway jsdom test, deleted afterwards, loaded the real sheets. It confirmed that the practice result keeps its own width, padding, 18 px corners, glow, entrance and 46 px gradient title over `.dialog`. It also showed the scrim at `var(--z-dialog)` and "Leave this game?" in the order Keep playing / Save and leave / Leave without saving, with the first on its own row.
- **Not run:** I did not look at the dialogs in a real browser, because the sandbox refused localhost and the Playwright CLI's install. The e2e specs that concede or leave keep every selector they use, but they were not run here; CI's e2e smoke runs them. I also did not run cargo clippy or cargo test, since no Rust changed.

## Decisions the issue did not settle

- **Layer:** `--z-dialog` (72) rather than `--z-modal` (40), which sits under the drag layer and level with the prompt's scrim. PracticeLeave moves up from 70 and PracticeResult from 60, so both now sit over the toasts and the drag layer, as concede already did.
- **Keys:** `useModalKeys` rather than `useModalOverlay`. Its Tab trap only works on `role="dialog"`, its Escape reaches the board, and on close it always puts the focus back on the opener, even over the caller's own move.
- **Order:** the Cancel and the safe choice come first and `danger` goes last. I rejected ordering purely by role, because a menu's Cancel/Send would then put the act first.
- **No actions:** if a `dialog` has no actions, the ✕ takes the focus. The plan did not cover this case.
- **Reduced motion:** I added `.dialog.practice-result` to practice.css's reduced-motion list. The plan missed this: without it the higher-specificity twin would keep the panel's entrance animation running under reduced motion.

## Look at twice

- **PracticeResult is now a Back layer.** Back, Escape, the new ✕ and a click outside all mean View the board. That is what "registered as a Back layer" asks for, but it changes R2127000's "result dialogs keep Back". The match's and the lessons' result dialogs keep Back as before.

  - The practice result's Play again and Change setup drop from 56 px to the Dialog's 44 px.
  - Its scrim no longer waits 300 ms; the panel still has its delayed entrance.
  - Concede's border loses its red tint.
- **Escape over the board:** PracticeLeave, ConfirmLeaveFight and PracticeResult now swallow Escape in the capture phase, so the board underneath no longer sees it.
- **For the next issue:** the practice.css twins stay until the lesson result (TutorialResult) moves onto `Dialog`, and can be removed then.
